scenarios.description: the whole fixture from the entry page — the deep walk the cost is in
six screens mounted at once, switched in memory — a reload loses what a route keeps
a panel revealed by a self-loop, whose controls exist only while it is open
a keypad that accumulates in the DOM and in no heading, so re-entry is invisible to the fingerprint
a page tall enough that every control is reached by scrolling
an app behind a tab-scoped session, walked with that session replayed
